description: A Digital Twin Builder Flow (preview) is a CHILD item of a Digital Twin Builder that executes its mapping and contextualization (relationship) operations, on-demand or on a schedule. Each DTB auto-creates an on-demand flow named '<dtb-name>OnDemand'; scheduling a mapping/contextualization operation creates additional scheduled flows. Flow execution is portal-driven (the Run button / a schedule); the public REST surface is item CRUD + definition only.

flags.--name: Display name (letters, numbers, underscores only — NO hyphens)
flags.--dtb-id: Parent Digital Twin Builder item id (REQUIRED — the flow is a child of a DTB)

notes: create requires the parent DTB via --dtb-id (creationPayload.digitalTwinBuilderItemReference, referenceType 'ById'); otherwise the API returns 'Parent artifact is inaccessible or required fields are missing.'
Item name allows only letters, numbers, and underscores — hyphens are NOT allowed.
Flows run mappings first, then contextualization operations; a failed operation cancels downstream operations. Prefer separate flows/schedules per operation to isolate failures.
On-demand vs scheduled: an on-demand flow is auto-created with the DTB; scheduled flows are created when you schedule a mapping/contextualization operation.
Flow run/execution is not exposed via a guessable public jobs job-type; it is triggered from the portal (Run button / schedule) or by fabric-managed schedules.
